text:
maria chen: Heads-up: we're seeing SLO alerts for /generate routing spikes. Need to decide how traces map to billing/owner when requests cross hosted <-> dedicated fallbacks.

sachin patel: Can you paste an example trace? Is this happening at ingress or after the router hands off?

maria chen: Sample (trimmed) below. The issue: one trace has spans in both hosted and dedicated runtimes so dashboards blame different teams. which owner should get SLO hit vs cost?

alex wong: By current default we attribute to the ingress tenant if a billing key is present. For SLOs we probably need an explicit slo_owner + cost_owner dimension instead of guessing.

devon: We already add route tags but they get dropped on fallback in a few places. Example span tags i saw:```
trace.tags:
  tenant_id: "acme"
  route: "dedicated"
  fallback: "hosted"
  model: "rwd-v2"
```

obs-bot: Notice: ingestion normalized 47 traces this morning with missing 'billing_owner' -> defaulted to tenant. :warning:

sam r: Proposal: enforce a canonical attribution header at ingress (X-RW-ATTR) that's signed by the edge. Router/runtime must copy it to every child span. If missing, router writes fallback_owner=router-service.

sachin patel: Question: how do we handle shared model pools where multiple product teams hit the same model? attribution should be by caller for billing, but SLOs might want the model owner too.

alex wong: Yep — suggest two orthogonal fields: cost_billing_owner (billing/chargeback) and slo_owner (alerting/ownership). Both should be explicit, immutable once set for a trace.

maria chen: Implementation idea: router writes both tags at handoff; runtime preserves them in KV cache + runtime span exporter marks them as immutable. Enrichment layer refuses overwrites.

nayan: Edge case: clients could fake X-RW-ATTR. We must require the header be issued/signed by our edge (JWT or HMAC) and validated before use.

devon: Ops concern: adding full owner metadata to every span increases payload. Might prefer a short attr_id that enrichment resolves to full metadata later.

sam r: Agreed. We can store attr_id in spans and run an attr-registry service that maps attr_id -> {cost_owner,slo_owner,annotations}. Registry is small and cached by enrichment.

sachin patel: Action items so we don't lose momentum: 1) RFC sketch for attr header + registry (maria) 2) runtime change to copy header into KV cache and export attr_id (devon) 3) obs infra change to treat attr_id as primary join key for SLO dashboards (alex).

maria chen: I'll draft the RFC today. @devon can you confirm runtime effort? @alex can you add expected query changes to dashboards? :thumbsup:

devon: Will do. Rough estimate: 3-4 dev days for runtime copy + tests, 1 day for infra rollout checks.

alex wong: I'll update dashboards and add unit tests for attribution mismatch alerts.

maria chen: Thanks all — I'll post RFC link here once it's up and move discussion to the RFC thread. Closing this ticket for now.
